Embark on an unforgettable journey to Bhutan with Reason To Flyy, where majestic Himalayan landscapes, ancient monasteries, colourful traditions, and peaceful valleys create the perfect holiday experience.
Discover the Highlights
Thimphu: Explore Bhutan’s charming capital, its cultural landmarks, local markets, and magnificent Buddha Dordenma statue.
Paro: Discover traditional Bhutanese architecture, beautiful valleys, and historic monasteries.
Tiger’s Nest Monastery: Experience the spectacular cliffside monastery of Taktsang, one of Bhutan’s most iconic attractions.
Punakha: Admire the stunning Punakha Dzong and picturesque river valleys, depending on your selected itinerary.
Himalayan Views: Enjoy scenic mountain drives, lush landscapes, and peaceful surroundings.

Why Choose Reason To Flyy?
Enjoy a thoughtfully planned holiday with comfortable stays, memorable sightseeing, and assistance throughout your journey. Whether you are travelling as a couple, with family, or with friends, Bhutan offers a refreshing escape into nature and culture.
Book Your Bhutan Holiday Today!
Discover the magic of the Himalayas with Reason To Flyy.
Itinerary
6 days · 5 nights
Day 1Day 1Arrival in Paro – Transfer to ThimphuParo
Arrive at Paro International Airport, where you will be welcomed by your local representative. Enjoy a scenic drive through Bhutan’s beautiful Himalayan landscapes to Thimphu, the charming capital city. After hotel check-in, relax or explore the local market and experience Bhutanese culture at your leisure.
Paro International Airport to Thimphu hotel by road
Overnight in Paro · Hotel
Day 2Day 2Thimphu Sightseeing – Discover the CapitalThimphu
After breakfast, explore Thimphu’s cultural highlights. Visit Buddha Dordenma, a magnificent Buddha statue overlooking the valley, and Tashichho Dzong, an impressive fortress and monastery. Explore the National Memorial Chorten and local handicraft shops to discover Bhutanese art, traditions, and daily life. Return to your hotel in the evening.
Hotel to Thimphu sightseeing locations and return
Overnight in Thimphu · Thimphu
MealsBreakfast
Day 3Day 3Thimphu to Punakha – Mountain Pass and Valley ViewsPunākha
After breakfast, check out and drive towards Punakha via the scenic Dochula Pass, known for its beautiful mountain views and collection of memorial chortens. On arrival in Punakha, visit the impressive Punakha Dzong, located at the confluence of the Pho Chhu and Mo Chhu rivers. Enjoy the peaceful valley surroundings before checking in to your hotel.
Thimphu hotel to Punakha hotel via Dochula Pass
Overnight in Punākha · Punakha
MealsBreakfast
Day 4Day 4Punakha to Paro – Culture and Scenic LandscapesParo
After breakfast, check out and enjoy the scenic drive back towards Paro. Depending on the schedule, visit local cultural attractions or stop at scenic viewpoints along the way. On arrival in Paro, check in to your hotel and spend the evening exploring the town, browsing local handicraft shops, or relaxing at your leisure.
Punakha hotel to Paro hotel
Overnight in Paro · Paro
MealsBreakfast
Day 5Day 5Paro Sightseeing – Tiger’s Nest MonasteryParo
After breakfast, visit the iconic Taktsang Monastery, popularly known as Tiger’s Nest, dramatically perched on a cliff above the Paro Valley. The hike offers spectacular views of the surrounding mountains and forest. The trek is moderately challenging and requires suitable footwear and a reasonable level of fitness. Spend the remainder of the day exploring Paro town or relaxing at your hotel.
Paro hotel to Tiger’s Nest trailhead and return
Overnight in Paro · Paro
MealsBreakfast
Day 6Day 6Departure from ParoParo
Enjoy breakfast at the hotel, subject to your flight schedule. Check out and transfer to Paro International Airport for your onward journey, carrying wonderful memories of Bhutan’s Himalayan landscapes, rich traditions, and peaceful valleys.
Paro hotel to Paro International Airport

Discover the magical beauty of Japan with Reason To Flyy, where timeless traditions meet modern wonders. From the dazzling skyline of Tokyo to the peaceful temples of Kyoto, Japan offers an extraordinary travel experience for every kind of explorer.
Visit iconic landmarks, admire the spectacular views of Mount Fuji, stroll through traditional Japanese gardens, explore historic shrines, and experience the excitement of Osaka’s famous entertainment and food districts.
Whether you are planning a romantic getaway, a family vacation, or an unforgettable international trip with friends, our Japan Holiday Package brings together culture, adventure, shopping, and relaxation.

After breakfast, explore Kuala Lumpur’s famous landmarks, including the Petronas Twin Towers photo stop, KL Tower surroundings, Independence Square, the National Monument, and the King’s Palace photo stop. Later, visit Putrajaya to admire its impressive architecture, scenic lakeside views, and the iconic Putra Mosque from permitted visitor areas. Return to your hotel in the evening.

After breakfast, proceed to Batu Caves, a renowned Hindu religious site featuring a colourful staircase and limestone cave temples. Continue to Genting Highlands, a mountain resort known for its cool climate, entertainment, shopping, and dining. Enjoy leisure time at the resort and take the cable car if operational and included in your package. Return to Kuala Lumpur in the evening.

After breakfast, explore Langkawi’s scenic attractions. Visit Eagle Square for photographs and enjoy the island’s beautiful coastal views. Explore Underwater World Langkawi if included in your package, followed by leisure time at Pantai Cenang or Pantai Tengah. You may also enjoy local shopping or relax by the beach.

Maui, Hawaii – Tropical Paradise Escape
Discover the breathtaking beauty of Maui, Hawaii, with golden beaches, turquoise waters, lush tropical landscapes, scenic coastal drives, spectacular sunsets, and unforgettable island experiences. Enjoy the perfect blend of relaxation, adventure, and Hawaiian culture with Reason To Flyy.

Escape to the tropical paradise of Maui, Hawaii, an island renowned for its pristine beaches, dramatic volcanic landscapes, lush rainforests, and vibrant Hawaiian culture.
Explore the scenic beauty of the famous Road to Hana, witness the stunning landscapes of Haleakalā National Park, relax on beautiful beaches, and experience the magic of Hawaiian sunsets. Enjoy opportunities for snorkeling, whale watching during the seasonal migration, exploring charming island towns, and discovering the island's unique local cuisine and traditions.
Whether you are planning a romantic getaway, a family holiday, or an adventure-filled escape, Maui offers an extraordinary island experience with something for every traveller.

Stunning beaches and crystal-clear waters
Scenic Road to Hana experience
Haleakalā volcanic landscapes and sunrise views

Spectacular sunsets and tropical relaxation
